script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The psalm does not say the servants are in a household or that they have no armor.
The claim that plenty of other psalms describe waiting for morning needs a reference.
“For that long” suggests a length of time the psalm does not give. It says they have endured much contempt.
The psalm says they have endured scorn, but it does not say whether the scorn is still happening.
The psalm calls Israel to declare, but it does not say Egypt was excluded or not invited.
The counterfactual describes what would have happened without the LORD; it does not say how close it came to happening.
The claim that chaff in the wind appears elsewhere in the Bible needs a reference.
The psalm does not say the bird should not have been able to escape.
The statement that David was a king needs a reference outside this passage.
